mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_invitation (org_id, code_hash, created_by, expires_at, max_uses, used_count, status) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{codeHash}, #{createdBy}, #{expiresAt}, #{maxUses}, 0, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, org_id, code_hash, created_by, expires_at, max_uses, used_count, status, created_at FROM organization_invitation WHERE code_hash = #{codeHash} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT id, org_id, code_hash, created_by, expires_at, max_uses, used_count, status, created_at FROM organization_invitation WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_invitation SET status = 'REVOKED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
